Overview of Thailand lending sector and NBFI consumer lending 
Farmer Financial Assistant Scheme 
(launched in October 2025 and ongoing under Phase 3)
⚫ Offers suspension of debt payments for up to three years for around 
2.7 million eligible farmers with outstanding debt of up to THB300k 
with state-owned banks and specialized financial institutions
Half-Half Plus Scheme 
(launched in October 2025)
⚫ Provides a 50% government co-payment on eligible purchases at 
participating local merchants to stimulate domestic consumption, 
support SMEs, promote local money circulation, and ease the cost -of-
living burden
"1,000 Baht per Rai" Subsidy Scheme 
(launched in September 2025 and ongoing for the 2025/26 crop year)
⚫ The government and BAAC supported low-income farmers through cost 
reduction, low-interest loans, crop insurance, and income subsidies of 
THB 1,000/rai (up to 15 rai), alongside knowledge-sharing seminars to 
promote sustainable self-reliance
